zh-CN.title: 欢迎消息与聊天体验保持一致
items: 欢迎消息编辑器现在直接使用聊天会话的气泡、媒体、头像框与背景样式
消息按新好友看到的接收方视角展示，并保留简洁的逐条删除操作

en.title: Welcome messages now match chat
items: The editor now uses the same bubbles, media, avatar frames, and backgrounds as chat
Messages appear from the recipient's point of view with a compact per-message delete action
